intro: Heart of Yew Tee is listed in our project file as an HDB development in Choa Chu Kang, with 68 units. URA, as cited in the file, says the development opens in 2027. That official note is important, and it is easy to misread: the 2027 opening is not key collection. Residential block TOP and key timing remain unconfirmed. A tracker claim of an October 2026 completion was contradicted by the URA timing and is not used here. Tenure and typologies are left blank. If you are waiting for keys to a flat, do not treat the estate’s opening year as your appointment date. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Heart of Yew Tee renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Heart of Yew Tee interior
sections.text:
Choa Chu Kang and Yew Tee form a mature western-north town, and a neighbourhood opening can matter for daily life — shops, connections, a more complete precinct — without telling you when a particular block will be handed over. For owners who do eventually collect keys, the interior work is still the usual HDB first fit-out: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, designed from the approved plan. Maison specifies built-in carpentry, not flat-pack furniture, and we will not invent a layout or a unit type for this page, because no official floor plan is on file.

Keat Hong Grange is already live on this site in Choa Chu Kang and is the natural nearby residential page. Tengah projects in this batch sit in the next town; they are not a typologies or key-date reference for Heart of Yew Tee. We will not invent walking times to Yew Tee MRT or to Choa Chu Kang town.

If you already have an HDB key letter, send it together with your approved plan and we can talk about a renovation sequence: defects, the HDB permit, then fabrication. If you only have the 2027 opening in mind, wait for a document that actually names your block and your appointment. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison when you have papers to share. We are not affiliated with HDB or URA.

faq.q: Do you have the floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved unit plan if you have one.

faq.q: Do I need an HDB renovation permit?
faq.a: For ordinary HDB renovation works, yes, after keys. Inspect defects first, then apply for the permit with a registered contractor before carpentry is fabricated.
Any approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key appointment if one is already in writing — not only the 2027 opening note. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
